Due to Google Cloud AI startups support program, we could make many of app features free. We hope you try and enjoy it on your next trip!

records.name: StockScan AI
records.tagline: Leveraging AI to scan technical data for stocks.
records.description: Find winning stocks in seconds with AI-powered research. StockScan analyzes 200+ stocks using Amazon Nova 2 to deliver actionable trade recommendations based on your selected budget. Track your positions and receive Buy/Hold/Sell recommendations based off technical factors and news.

records.name: Lutum Veritas Research
records.tagline: Open source deep research
records.description: The very First Deep Reserach tool wich dont censor. only real.raw.research Lutum Veritas is different: - Recursive pipeline: each research point builds on previous findings - Camoufox scraper: 0% bot detection, bypasses paywalls - Academic mode: 200k+ character outputs with evidence tables - BYOK: bring your API key, pay only ~$0.20 per session Desktop app with live progress. Solo dev project. AGPL licensed. Windows installer

records.name: ThinkShift
records.tagline: Compare 3 AIs with a smart summary and Brainstorming
records.description: ThinkShift lets you ask once and instantly compare answers from ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini—plus a 3-second smart summary of what’s common and what differs. Then tap a button to challenge, expand, or rewrite any answer with another model, without copy-pasting. Built for power users who want faster brainstorming and better decisions.

records.name: DestMate
records.tagline: Alarm with location wake-up and earphone-only sound
records.description: Wake up exactly when you need to—even on long rides. 🚆 DestMate is a smart, location-based travel alarm for commuters and travelers. Set your destination and get alerted as you approach, privately through your headphones or earbuds. Includes a time failsafe, missed-stop alerts, ETA tracking, QR alarm sharing, and offline maps. Battery-efficient, privacy-first, and perfect for napping on the go. Arrive awake, not anxious.

records.name: Review Lift
records.tagline: Turn customer feedback into real Google reviews.
records.description: Most review tools focus on collecting reviews. Review Lift focuses on what happens after feedback is given. Instead of pushing every customer to Google and hoping for the best, Review Lift separates private feedback from public reviews in a clean, compliant way. All customers are invited to share feedback, but only satisfied customers are prompted to leave a public Google review. Lower feedback stays private so businesses can resolve issues internally.

records.name: Binance NFT Marketplace Clone Script
records.tagline: End-to-End Binance NFT Clone with Wallet Integration
records.description: Our Binance NFT Marketplace Clone Script helps you launch your own NFT platform without the usual complexity. It supports minting, buying, selling, auctions, and creator royalties. Built to handle high traffic, it works across multiple blockchains and wallets. You get full admin control, smooth transactions, and a clean, flexible interface—so you can go live faster and scale confidently as your marketplace grows.
